QuestInfo.name: Constructing Neo Huroid 1
QuestInfo.0: Humanoid A now has the #t4033849#. Help Humandoid A to produce Neo Huroid.
QuestInfo.1: #r#t4009065##k and #r#t4009067##k is needed to get the most basic outward appearance according to #t4033849#.
QuestInfo.2: You've gathered the materials needed to produce Neo Huroid for Humanoid A.

0.0: #r#t4033849##k... Yes, Dr. De Lang said he considers me his child. So, if I make a Neo Huroid myself then I will be the parent, correct? My heart is beating 43% faster than normal. At least, that's what the sensors say.
0.1: Let's see... "Neo Huroid Development Chapter 1: Appearance. The first step in producing a Neo Huroid is to craft its appearance. This is the framework for the rest of the Neo Huroid key components..."
0.2: I want to start with a round face. I don't like the angled chin that Dr. De Lang gave me. It looks too much like...Dr. De Lang. Anyway, I'll need some parts to get started. Will you help?

yes.0: Materials needed: #r15 #t4009065##k, #r15 #t4009067##k. Wow, I am made of Steel and Mithril Plates, too. I guess I can make my child with the same parts!

no.0: Why can't it be easy? With the #t4033849#?

1.0: I have been desperately waiting for your return. Let me have the stuff you brought back. I will do the actual constructing myself, so I can feel that deep connection.

yes.0: Okay, the initial framework is up. What do you think? I think it's the cutest thing ever!

default.0: #r15 #t4009065##k and #r15 #t4009067##k items are required to get started on the Neo Huroid.
